footer.tagline: National Atmospheric Intelligence & Exposure Decision Platform
footer.desc: SanjhiHawa delivers verified atmospheric telemetry, boundary layer thermal inversion forecasting, and aerosol exposure mitigation planning for Indian metropolitan corridors. All physical modeling, inhaled dosage metrics, and indoor filtration balances are computed directly from deterministic environmental health physics.
footer.privacy_note: Zero Accounts: All household profiles and member vulnerabilities remain strictly in browser localStorage. Calculations run on transient, ephemeral API calls.
footer.health_notice: SanjhiHawa provides atmospheric modeling and clean air exposure mitigation tools for daily household planning.
footer.heuristic_note: Particulate-to-cigarette dosage comparison is an epidemiological communication heuristic (Berkeley Earth, 2015) based on equivalent mortality risk from fine particulate mass inhalation.

landing.provenance_title: Why Roadside Ground Monitors Differ from Regional Atmospheric Grids
landing.provenance_desc: When comparing air quality platforms across Indian cities (e.g. Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi), users frequently observe apparent divergence between commercial websites and numerical atmospheric models. Here is the peer-reviewed scientific proof of how sampling volume, sensor physics, and meteorological convection operate.
landing.p1_desc: Roadside sensors capture vehicle tailpipes and brake friction 2 meters above asphalt. SanjhiHawa’s ECMWF CAMS model calculates the integrated ~120 km² regional boundary layer, encompassing parks, residential neighborhoods, and open terrain.
landing.p2_desc: Low-cost optical counters mistake condensed water droplets during high relative humidity or morning inversions for heavy PM2.5 (hygroscopic swelling). CAMS assimilates Sentinel-5P, MODIS, and calibrated reference BAM stations under strict chemical equations.
landing.p3_desc: For a roadside reading of 98 µg/m³, CPCB piecewise interpolation produces AQI 223. For a regional reading of 29 µg/m³, it produces AQI 49. The mathematical engine is 100% identical; only the physical volume being measured differs.
landing.p4_desc: Commercial platforms are frequently operated by air purifier manufacturers who benefit from displaying localized maximum readings. CAMS is managed by the European Union Earth Observation Programme with zero commercial hardware interest.
landing.applies_title: How SanjhiHawa Applies This in Practice
landing.applies_desc: Use regional atmospheric models for household exposure budgeting, daily routine timing, and residential purifier sizing. Use roadside ground monitors when walking directly alongside arterial highways or active construction corridors.

how_it_works.title: How SanjhiHawa Works
how_it_works.subtitle: Complete disclosure of physical mass-balance formulas, epidemiological constants, data sources, heuristic boundaries, and privacy guarantees.
how_it_works.cardinal_title: The LLM Never Does The Math
how_it_works.cardinal_desc: Large Language Models are non-deterministic and prone to arithmetic hallucination. In SanjhiHawa, every number—inhaled dose in micrograms, linear CPCB AQI sub-indices, room steady-state mass balances, Berkeley Earth cigarette-equivalents, schedule shifts, and rupee efficiency scores—is calculated exclusively inside a pure-Python, framework-independent engine. The LLM is invoked strictly as a narrating interface to format and personalize verified tool outputs.
